description: Audit all 34 high-score parts across two seeds and every first heavy strike. Hold back one hammer, then search without cross or collectible effects. Adjust only parts whose lower-decile score has less than 15% headroom; new target is 80% of that score rounded down to 5. Validate changed parts on two independent seeds and every first heavy strike, still reserving a hammer. Search witnesses are not player win rates or proven maxima.
